messages.content: Hey, I just caught up with Wanghao about the Double Eleven sale prep. Can you update our engineering notes?
Sure thing! What's the latest from Wanghao?

Good news. Following their weekend optimization work, Wanghao concluded that the checkout service can now safely handle a peak of 15,000 QPS for the Double Eleven sale. Much better than the 12k we were at last week.
That's a massive improvement! 15,000 QPS should give the system a lot more breathing room. Did he have any other updates?

Not on the technical side, mostly just chit-chat. He mentioned he wants to buy a new mechanical keyboard during the Double Eleven sale. He also joked that the office coffee machine will probably break from overuse during the event.
Haha, he's probably not wrong about the coffee machine! You guys might need a backup. Any other logistics on your mind?
Yeah, it got me thinking. I wonder if we should order pizza for the team on the night of the Double Eleven sale? Just to keep morale up. Remind me to run that by Boss Zhang later.
Will do! I'll remind you to ask about the pizza later. I've logged the new 15,000 QPS checkout capacity. Let me know if you need anything else!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-04, Wanghao concluded that the checkout service can safely handle a peak of 15,000 QPS for the Double Eleven sale following the weekend optimization.

messages.content: Hey, I just wrapped up the mid-quarter goals adjustment meeting. The OKR review took a while.
Welcome back! How did the OKR review go? Need me to jot down any updates?

Yeah, please do. First off, I just have to say the conference room felt unusually cold during the OKR review. I was freezing the whole time. Plus, Boss Zhang mentioned he had a slight headache before starting the review, so the vibe was a bit tense at first.
Yikes, a freezing room and a headache aren't the best combo for a big meeting. Did you guys still manage to get through the agenda?

We did, thankfully someone brought a box of assorted pastries to share, which definitely helped everyone push through. Anyway, the main takeaway is that Boss Zhang made the final decision to merge the user retention metric into the overall sales target during the OKR review.
Got it. That's a pretty significant shift for the team's focus. I'll log Boss Zhang's decision on the metrics. Anything else you need me to update?
Nope, that's the only major conclusion. I'm going to go grab a hot tea to thaw out now.
Sounds like a solid plan. Enjoy your tea, and let me know if you need anything else later!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-04, Boss Zhang made the final decision to merge the user retention metric into the overall sales target during the OKR review.

messages.content: Hey, I need to vent. I was just talking to Sister Chen about the OKR review we had today, and I am so incredibly frustrated right now.
I'm here to listen. What happened during the OKR review that's got you so frustrated?

They completely cut my personal growth goals from the OKRs. After Boss Zhang merged the user retention metric into the sales target yesterday, I guess they just decided my development didn't matter. I was expressing my intense frustration to Sister Chen about it, and it just sucks.

That is incredibly frustrating, especially after all the hard work you've been putting in for the Double Eleven prep. It's totally unfair to just drop your growth goals like that. Was Sister Chen supportive?

Yeah, she was. She even asked if I had time to eat lunch after the OKR review since it ran so long and stressful. To make matters worse, I was so distracted that I left my favorite pen in the meeting room during the OKR review.
Oh no, not the favorite pen! That's just adding insult to injury on a rough day. I hope you at least managed to grab a quick bite to eat?

I did, finally. Sister Chen also tried to lighten the mood by pointing out that the slides used in the OKR review had a really weird font choice. It made me chuckle a bit, but I'm still really upset about my goals.

I'm glad she could make you laugh a little with the font comment, but it's completely valid that you're still upset. Let me know if you want to brainstorm ways to bring your growth goals back to the table later.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-05, Linchen expressed intense frustration to Sister Chen because his personal growth goals were completely cut during the OKR review.

messages.content: Hey, I need you to update my calendar for this weekend. I just rescheduled the dentist appointment to Sunday morning at 10:00 AM instead of Saturday.
Got it! I've moved your dentist appointment to Sunday at 10:00 AM. Do you need me to adjust anything else on your weekend schedule?
Not right now. But I need to figure out the driving situation. Jiange asked if the clinic for the dentist appointment has free parking available since he's giving me a ride.
I can look up the clinic's parking info for you if you'd like. Want me to check?
Yeah, do that later. Honestly, Jiange mentioned he absolutely hates the smell of the waiting room at any dentist appointment, so he'll probably just wait in the car anyway.
Haha, fair enough! Waiting in the car sounds like a safe bet for him to avoid the clinic smell.
For sure. I also joked that my mouth will be entirely numb for hours after the dentist appointment, so he's definitely going to make fun of how I talk when we get lunch afterward.
I can already picture the jokes! Good luck with the appointment, and I'll make sure your Sunday schedule is all set.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-06, Linchen rescheduled the dentist appointment to Sunday morning at 10:00 AM instead of Saturday.

messages.content: Hey, I just finished my weekly catch-up call with Mom. We mostly talked about my upcoming dentist appointment.
How's she doing? Still checking up on your schedule since you moved the appointment to Sunday at 10 AM?
Yeah, she's doing well. She was telling me that her neighbor also had a dentist appointment recently and complained a lot about the cost.
Ouch, yeah, dental bills can be pretty brutal. Are you all set for Sunday?
I think so. I just really need to remember my insurance card for the dentist appointment so I don't end up paying a fortune like her neighbor did.
I'll make sure to remind you Sunday morning to grab your insurance card. Did Mom have any specific requests for this visit?

Yeah, besides the whitening options we talked about before, I actually promised Mom I would ask the doctor for a specialized fluoride treatment during the dentist appointment. She also asked what I plan to eat for dinner after the dentist appointment, since my mouth will probably be totally numb.
Good call on the fluoride treatment, I'll log that promise for you. And she makes a fair point about dinner—maybe plan for some soup or smoothies just in case!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-06, Linchen promised Mom he would ask the doctor for a specialized fluoride treatment during the dentist appointment.

messages.content: Hey, I need to jot down some updates about the apartment hunting with Liwei.
Sure thing! Still on track to secure a lease by mid-August? How did the search go today?
Well, the search itself was a bit of a mess. I'm pretty annoyed because my shoes got completely muddy while we were out looking at places today.
Ugh, ruined shoes are never fun. Did you guys at least find any places with good water pressure or a nice balcony to make up for the mud?

Not really, but Liwei's spirits were high. She mentioned she saw a really cute stray cat while walking back from the apartment hunting. She also suggested we grab bubble tea before we resume looking tomorrow.
Bubble tea and cute cats are great stress relievers! Are you guys planning to change your strategy since you noticed rents were 15% higher?
Yeah, exactly. I actually made a serious commitment to Liwei today that I will increase our monthly budget by 1000 RMB for the apartment hunting. We just have to bite the bullet.
Got it. I'll remember that you committed to bumping up the budget by 1000 RMB. Hopefully, that extra room opens up some great options for you two tomorrow!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-07, Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei that he will increase their monthly budget by 1000 RMB for the apartment hunting.

messages.content: Hey, I was just chatting with Sister Chen about the apartment hunting. She asked if we're using a broker and recommended this new real estate app to help us look.
That's helpful of her! Are you going to try the app? Finding a good place without a broker can be tough.

Yeah, I'll probably download it tonight. I told her I really prefer high-rise buildings when doing the apartment hunting, so hopefully this app has good filters for that. But honestly, I'm kind of freaking out right now.
Oh no, what's wrong? Is it because the rents were 15% higher than you expected?

Exactly. I just agreed with Liwei to increase our monthly budget by 1000 RMB to get a decent place. But right after I said yes, I felt this sharp pang of financial anxiety. I just vented to Sister Chen about it.
That's completely understandable. An extra 1000 RMB a month is a real commitment. It's good you let it out to Sister Chen, though.
Yeah, she always listens when I stress about money. I'm just going to have to sit down and redo my entire monthly budget to make this work.
Good plan. Let me know if you want me to pull up your expense tracker later so we can run the numbers together. Hang in there!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-07, Linchen expressed to Sister Chen that he felt a sharp pang of financial anxiety after agreeing to increase the budget for the apartment hunting.

messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the vendor selection meeting for the Double Eleven sale. Man, I've got a sore throat from all these back-to-back meetings.
Ouch, make sure to drink some warm water and rest your voice! How did the vendor meeting go?
It was pretty intense. Boss Zhang made the final decision to exclude third-party electronics vendors from the main landing page of the Double Eleven sale this year.
Wow, that's a massive shift. Did he mention why they're getting bumped off the main page?
Mostly quality control and margin issues. Also, someone suggested creating a new Slack channel just for the Double Eleven sale to keep all this organized, which we'll probably do.
A dedicated channel sounds like a smart move with how much is going on. Anything else come up?
Yeah, Boss Zhang noted that the graphic design team is running behind on banners for the Double Eleven sale, so we need to push them on that. Anyway, I'm going to go make some tea.
Sounds like a plan. Go get that tea and give your throat a break! I'll make a note of the vendor decision.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-08, Boss Zhang made the final decision to exclude third-party electronics vendors from the main landing page of the Double Eleven sale.

Yeah, Jiange joked that I'll be an expert on local neighborhoods after the apartment hunting is over. He's probably right! Anyway, just make sure that 2:30 PM slot is blocked off.
All set! Your 2:30 PM slot is firmly blocked for the loft viewing. Good luck today!
